dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregularly shaped, light-intensity (high-pixel-value) rings with jagged, high-contrast perimeters that define 'O' and 'C' shaped geometries against a darker dorsal background.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of low-intensity (dark) pixel clusters localized within the centers of the light-colored macro-annuli, particularly concentrated on the anterior dorsal and mid-lateral surfaces.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A prominent cluster of four macro-annuli centroids forms a rough trapezoidal geometric relationship on the anterior-lateral region, followed by a series of centroids forming a segmented linear chain extending posteriorly.
